name: GXO Logistics Distribution Center - Palmyra PA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Access road runs from a signalized public intersection at the SW and wraps around the building; no barrier arm, sliding gate or checkpoint pinch-point visible at the property line in z19/z20 satellite. No perimeter fence around the operational yard. Classed false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No 1-3-vehicle booth at the entrance or anywhere along the access road in z19 satellite or Street View. Site is open.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Very large distribution complex (Eastern Distribution Center / Hershey campus) with continuous dock-door banks on the north, south, east and west faces; counted ~220 doors across all faces - well into the 50+ band. Exact count approximate.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock doors run from physically distinct banks on multiple separate building faces (north and south banks especially), so shipping and receiving operate from separate clusters.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Hundreds of trailers parked in dedicated drop lots on the north, east and west sides, separate from active dock aprons - 50+ band.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The internal access road and dock courts easily hold queues of well over 3 trucks.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail spur runs along the south/SE edge of the property with rail cars visible in z19/z20 imagery; the spur enters the site footprint.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Appears to be one very large connected distribution building (~1.5M+ SF) with multiple wings; treated as a single building. Smaller separate buildings sit off-property to the SE and SW and are not part of this site.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Facility sits in open farmland on the rural edge of Palmyra PA; surrounded by crop fields - Rural.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane access road and very large paved aprons give ample room to add an express/bypass lane.
